prompt: Our ArgoCD app-of-apps root prunes children. When I delete a child Application from Git, its Deployments keep running. Why, and what is the safe way to retire a child so its resources go too?

On DigitalOcean Kubernetes we scale the node pool to 0 overnight and back to 2 in the morning. After scale-up, switching the ingress Service from NodePort back to LoadBalancer is rejected with 'Load Balancer not found'. What is going on and how do we fix it permanently?
DigitalOcean refused our morning node pool resize with 'region has insufficient capacity for pool resize for slug: s-2vcpu-4gb'. Design a resilient scale-up for a scheduled scale-to-zero cluster.

I need to move a Bitnami Sealed Secret to a new name and namespace. The old SealedSecret was created with default scope. What exactly do I have to do, and what will fail if I just edit the YAML metadata?

We run kube-prometheus-stack with alertmanagerConfigMatcherStrategy None. One tenant's AlertmanagerConfig has the only Discord receiver and a Watchdog heartbeat route. We are removing that tenant. How do we keep cluster alerting working, step by step, with verification?

A node pool was created by hand with the cloud CLI. Bring it under Terraform (digitalocean provider) without recreating it, keeping node_count owned by an external scheduler. Show the config and the import approach for Terraform 1.5+.

Our Kubernetes API sits behind a DigitalOcean load balancer whose IP changes every morning. Cloudflare proxied A records go stale and clients get 526. Design the DNS update so it never depends on GitHub Actions runners.

Should we move our public API from a cloud load balancer to a Cloudflare Tunnel to avoid the daily IP change? Our per-user rate limiting relies on the client IP. Lay out the trade-offs and what breaks.

After deleting a namespace that hosted an ingress-nginx controller, new Ingress objects across the cluster fail to create. What was left behind and what is the checklist of cluster-scoped leftovers to remove when retiring a controller?
A namespace is stuck in Terminating for 20 minutes after deletion. Give me a safe diagnostic and removal procedure that does not orphan cloud resources.

Our Prometheus Probe CRDs via blackbox-exporter check an API that will no longer exist. Which objects in a kube-prometheus-stack setup reference a removed service, and how do I find all of them by their GitOps tracking annotation?

Put Grafana behind Cloudflare Access with JWT auto-login so the owner never sees the Grafana login form, while keeping the admin form as a fallback. What are the Grafana settings and the risks of making every Access-authenticated user an admin?

A DigitalOcean Function on a cron trigger scales our cluster up each morning. Nodes sometimes take 30 minutes to become Ready, past the function's 15-minute limit, so later steps never run. Redesign the function so slow nodes cannot leave the cluster half-configured.

We use cert-manager with DNS-01 via Cloudflare for api.example.com. We are deleting the api record and ingress. What cert-manager objects should be removed, and how do we avoid the ACME solver retrying forever?

Before deleting a managed Postgres instance that a retired app used, what should I verify about other consumers, backups and connection strings across a Kubernetes cluster and several repos? Give a checklist with the commands you would run.

GitHub Actions minutes keep running out mid-month and scheduled workflows start hours late. Which of our automations (DNS updates, cluster scale, deploys) should move off Actions and to what, and which can stay?

Build and push our API container image locally with Podman on Windows (no Docker Desktop), run tests and Trivy first, and tag it so local releases never collide with CI run numbers. Outline the script.

A Cloudflare Pages site reads live metrics from a Prometheus behind Cloudflare Access using a service token. Design the Access policy, tunnel path restriction and Pages secrets so only this one query endpoint is reachable.
Add a Discord notification to a scheduled serverless job so we hear about failures and about fallback paths being taken, without the webhook URL ending up in the repo.
Several AI agents work on one repo at the same time using git worktrees. Set out the rules for branches, stashes, node_modules junctions on Windows and cleanup so they cannot clobber each other.
